name: BAND
summary: Six players on one board: drums you knock or draw on a grid, bass, lead, keys, ocarina and tuned feedback, in one key and tempo. Syncs with a SING.
author: willbearfruits
status_note: Runs on a board: about 45 % CPU idle, 55 % with drums, bass, keys and lead playing, no dropouts (2026-10-15). Not played much yet. Off the install page since 2026-11-22: its CPU-time checks pass on a desktop but fail on GitHub's shared build machines, which blocked the page. Back on once that is sorted.
